name: Life Stories We Admire
vocabTopics: Expressing pleasure and responding to it

notes.title: Quá khứ đơn và quá khứ tiếp diễn (Past simple vs. Past continuous)
notes.body:
1. Quá khứ đơn (V2/V-ed; did/didn't + V)
• Hành động đã hoàn tất trong quá khứ: I read a good book last night.
• Các sự kiện chính nối tiếp nhau trong câu chuyện: Mary read a few pages of her book and went to bed.
• Hành động ngắn xen vào hành động đang diễn ra: I was reading a book when the phone rang.

2. Quá khứ tiếp diễn (was/were + V-ing)
• Hành động đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ: I was reading a good book at 10 p.m. last night.
• Bối cảnh (setting) của câu chuyện: It was raining heavily outside. Mary read a few pages of her book and went to bed.
• Hành động dài bị hành động khác xen vào: She was killed by the enemy while she was doing her duty in the jungle.
• Hai (hay nhiều) hành động xảy ra song song: While I was reading a book, my mother was watching TV.

3. Cấu trúc với when / while
• S + was/were + V-ing + when + S + V2/ed.
• While + S + was/were + V-ing, S + V2/ed.
• While + S + was/were + V-ing, S + was/were + V-ing.
→ while thường đi với hành động dài (QKTD); when thường đi với hành động ngắn (QKĐ).

4. Dấu hiệu: at + giờ + thời gian quá khứ (at 9 p.m. on 30 April), at this time last year, when, while, as; QKĐ: yesterday, last…, ago, in + năm, at the age of…

5. Lỗi hay gặp
• Dùng QKTD cho chuỗi hành động hoàn tất: ✗ She was finishing school and was applying to college at 18 → ✓ She finished school and applied to college at 18.
• Dùng QKTD cho hành động ngắn: ✗ … when the phone was ringing → ✓ … when the phone rang.
• Dùng QKTD với động từ trạng thái (love, know, want, believe): ✗ he was wanting → ✓ he wanted.
• Đặt while trước hành động ngắn: ✗ I was reading while the phone rang → ✓ I was reading when the phone rang.

notes.title: Nguyên âm đôi /eɪ/ và /əʊ/
notes.body:
1. /eɪ/: bắt đầu từ /e/ rồi lướt sang /ɪ/, miệng mở rồi khép dần, môi hơi bè.
Cách viết thường gặp: a (+ phụ âm + e): age, saved, translated, famous; ai: painting, fail; ay: day, stay; ea (ít): great, break, steak; ey: they, obey.
Ví dụ trong sách: age, saved, translated, against (sách xếp vào /eɪ/; từ điển Oxford ưu tiên /əˈɡenst/).

2. /əʊ/: bắt đầu từ /ə/ rồi lướt sang /ʊ/, môi tròn dần.
Cách viết thường gặp: o (+ phụ âm + e): wrote, home, hope; o + ld/lt: soldier, old, cold; ow: shows, grow, known; oa: boat, coast; ou (ít): soul, shoulder, though.
Ví dụ trong sách: soldier, wrote, hero, shows.

3. Ngoại lệ hay bị hỏi
• a đọc /æ/: family, cancer, talent; ai đọc /e/: said, again; ay đọc /e/: says.
• o đọc /ʌ/: love, come, mother; oa đọc /ɔː/: broad; ow đọc /aʊ/: crown, down, how; ou đọc /aʊ/: about, found(ed).
• ea thường đọc /iː/ (leader, mean) hoặc /e/ (death, bread); chỉ vài từ đọc /eɪ/: great, break, steak.

notes.title: Cụm từ về câu chuyện cuộc đời (Life stories)
notes.body:
• (to) attend school/college: đi học (ở trường/đại học) – My father attended college in Ha Noi.
• (to) have a happy/difficult childhood: có tuổi thơ hạnh phúc/khó khăn.
• (to be) admired for (something): được ngưỡng mộ vì… – Uncle Ho was admired for his simple lifestyle.
• (to) have a long marriage: có cuộc hôn nhân lâu dài.
• impressive achievement(s): thành tựu ấn tượng.
• devote (one's youth/life) to + V-ing/N: cống hiến cho… – She devoted her youth to saving other people's lives.
• volunteer to do sth: tình nguyện làm gì; join the army: nhập ngũ.

Từ trong bài đọc Steve Jobs (tr. 11): be adopted by (được nhận nuôi), drop out (of college) (bỏ học), bond over (gắn bó vì cùng…), contribute to (đóng góp vào), be diagnosed with (được chẩn đoán mắc), pass away (qua đời), genius (thiên tài), cutting-edge (tiên tiến nhất), blockbuster (phim bom tấn).
Word family: achieve – achievement; admire – admiration – admirable; determine – determination – determined; intelligent – intelligence; marry – marriage – married; talent – talented.

notes.title: Everyday English: bày tỏ niềm vui và đáp lại
notes.body:
Bày tỏ niềm vui: … is/was amazing/wonderful/great. · That was a(n) amazing/wonderful/great … · It is/was (such) a pleasure to … · I was so pleased to … · I'm on top of the world / on cloud nine / over the moon.
Đáp lại: Wow! · I'm so happy/excited for you. · Good for you! · That's fantastic/amazing/great! · I'm pleased to hear (that you like it).
Ví dụ: Mark: I'm on top of the world! My poem has won the first prize. – Nam: I'm so happy for you! It's a very inspiring poem.

notes.title: Mẹo làm bài
notes.body:
• Chia thì: tìm mốc thời gian. Giờ cụ thể trong quá khứ (at 9 p.m. yesterday, at this time last year) → QKTD; chuỗi hành động nối bằng and/then → QKĐ; when + hành động ngắn → QKĐ; while + hành động dài → QKTD.
• Động từ trạng thái (love, like, know, want, believe, own) không chia tiếp diễn.
• Tìm lỗi sai: soát thì của từng động từ gạch chân, giới từ đi kèm (admired for, devote to, contribute to, diagnosed with, drop out of) và từ loại sau tính từ/sở hữu (his impressive achievements).
• Phát âm: nhóm theo chữ cái (a, ai, ay, o, ow, oa, ou, ea) rồi tìm từ ngoại lệ (said, says, love, crown, broad, leader).
• Trọng âm: danh từ/tính từ 2 âm tiết thường nhấn âm 1 (surgeon, childhood), động từ 2 âm tiết thường nhấn âm 2 (admire, adopt, devote, defeat); đuôi -ity, -ic, -tion nhấn ngay trước đuôi.
• Đọc điền: xem chỗ trống cần từ loại gì (sau a/an/the/tính từ → danh từ; sau be → tính từ/V-ing/V3), rồi mới xét nghĩa.

vocab.ex: She wrote her diary while she was working in a field hospital.
She studied medicine in Ha Noi.
She volunteered to join the army at the age of 24.
She worked as a surgeon during the resistance war against the US.
She worked as a surgeon during the resistance war against the US.
She was working in a field hospital in Quang Ngai Province.
The diary contains personal accounts of her experiences during the war.
More than 30 years after Tram's death, a copy was returned to her mother.
The diary was published in Viet Nam in 2005.
It has also been translated into several other languages.
Now she is considered a national hero.
She devoted her youth and whole life to saving other people's lives.
My father started his own business in his youth.
My father attended college in Ha Noi between the ages of 19 and 21.

vocab.vi: có tuổi thơ hạnh phúc/khó khăn
vocab.ex: My friend had a difficult childhood because his mother died when he was very small.
Uncle Ho was admired for his simple lifestyle.

vocab.vi: có cuộc hôn nhân lâu dài
vocab.ex: My grandparents had a long marriage. They were together for 60 years.
Thomas Edison's impressive achievements include the development of the light bulb.
He was adopted by Clara and Paul Jobs.
His biological parents were not married and gave him up for adoption.

vocab.vi: gắn bó với nhau nhờ (sở thích chung)
vocab.ex: They bonded over their love of electronics.
Jobs attended Reed College, but found the classes boring and dropped out after six months.

vocab.vi: dễ tiếp cận, dễ sử dụng
vocab.ex: They made computers smaller, cheaper, and accessible to everyday users.

vocab.vi: tiên tiến nhất, hiện đại nhất
vocab.ex: Apple products were designed to be cutting-edge technology.
Jobs contributed to computer animation.
Toy Story was followed by other blockbusters.
In 2003, Jobs was diagnosed with a rare form of pancreatic cancer.
He fought cancer bravely for several years.
Two months later, he passed away.
Apple has lost a visionary and creative genius.
Apple has lost a visionary and creative genius.
General Vo Nguyen Giap was a military genius.

vocab.vi: tiến hành một cuộc tấn công
vocab.ex: In 1948, Vo Thi Sau carried out attacks against French soldiers.
Walt Disney had a talent for drawing and painting.

vocab.vi: họa sĩ làm phim hoạt hình
vocab.ex: Walt Disney worked as an artist, animator, film producer and businessman.
Write a biography of Walt Disney for your school newspaper.
I'm on top of the world! My poem has won the first prize.
Cleopatra was most famous for her determination and beauty.
She was also very intelligent and well educated.
She was intelligent, ambitious, and dedicated to her adopted country.
Catherine II was dedicated to her adopted country.
Queen Elizabeth I ruled England for 45 years.
She defeated the powerful Spanish Navy in 1588.
She expanded the Russian Empire.

passages.title: My grandmother's life story
passages.text: My grandmother is the person I admire most. She was born in a small village in Quang Nam in 1950 and had a difficult (1) _____ because her family was very poor. She could not (2) _____ school regularly, so she taught herself to read by candlelight. In 1968, she (3) _____ in the rice fields when a group of soldiers asked her to help carry food to the front. She agreed immediately and spent the next five years working as a volunteer nurse. After the war, she married my grandfather, and they had a long and happy (4) _____. Although she never became famous, she devoted her whole life (5) _____ helping others. Today, people in our village still remember her kindness, and I am very proud to tell her story to my friends.

passages.title: Marie Curie – a life of determination
passages.text: Marie Curie is one of the most (6) _____ scientists in history. She was born in Warsaw, Poland, in 1867. As a girl, she was not allowed to go to university in her country, so she moved to Paris in 1891 to study physics and mathematics. While she (7) _____ at the university there, she met Pierre Curie, (8) _____ later became her husband. Together, they worked hard on radioactivity and discovered two new elements. In 1903, Marie became the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, and in 1911 she won a second one. Her achievements were truly (9) _____ because women at that time had very few chances to study science. Sadly, years of working with radiation damaged her health, and she (10) _____ away in 1934. Today, she is still admired for her intelligence, hard work and determination.

questions.q: Steve Jobs was _____ by Clara and Paul Jobs shortly after his birth, so they raised him as their own child.
questions.explain: be adopted by: được (ai) nhận làm con nuôi – hợp với 'raised him as their own child'. admired (ngưỡng mộ), attended (theo học), devoted (cống hiến) không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: Jobs attended Reed College, but he found the classes boring and _____ after six months.
questions.explain: drop out (of college): bỏ học giữa chừng. passed away = qua đời; carried out = tiến hành; looked after = chăm sóc – đều không hợp ngữ cảnh.

questions.q: My grandparents had a long _____. They lived happily together for 60 years.
questions.explain: have a long marriage: có cuộc hôn nhân lâu dài – hợp với 'lived together for 60 years'. childhood (tuổi thơ), achievement (thành tựu), youth (tuổi trẻ) không hợp.

questions.q: Uncle Ho was admired _____ his simple lifestyle.
questions.explain: Cụm cố định: be admired for something – được ngưỡng mộ vì điều gì. Các giới từ of, with, about không đi với admired theo nghĩa này.

questions.q: Dang Thuy Tram devoted her youth _____ saving other people's lives in the war.
questions.explain: devote something to + V-ing/N: cống hiến cái gì cho… (to là giới từ nên theo sau là saving). for, on, in không đi với devote.

questions.q:
Choose the word(s) CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word(s).
Two months after he stopped working, Steve Jobs <u>passed away</u>.
questions.explain: pass away = die (qua đời), cách nói nhẹ nhàng. retired = nghỉ hưu, moved away = chuyển đi, recovered = hồi phục.

questions.q:
Choose the word(s) CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word(s).
Apple has lost a visionary and creative <u>genius</u>.
questions.explain: genius: thiên tài – người cực kỳ thông minh, tài năng. Ba phương án còn lại (người bình thường, nhân viên chăm chỉ, nhà đầu tư giàu có) không mang nghĩa này.

questions.q:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
My friend had a <u>difficult</u> childhood because his mother died when he was very small.
questions.explain: have a happy/difficult childhood là cặp trái nghĩa trong sách: difficult (khó khăn) ↔ happy (hạnh phúc). hard gần nghĩa với difficult; lonely, poor không phải từ trái nghĩa.

questions.q: Thomas Edison's _____ in science include the invention of the phonograph and the development of the light bulb.
questions.explain: Sau sở hữu cách Edison's cần danh từ; động từ include (số nhiều) → danh từ số nhiều achievements (những thành tựu). achieve (v), achievable (adj), achieved (V3) sai từ loại.

questions.q: Walt Disney had a great _____ for drawing and painting.
questions.explain: Sau a great cần danh từ số ít: a talent for something – năng khiếu về… talented/talentless là tính từ; talents số nhiều không đi với a.

questions.q: Elizabeth I was admired for her strong _____ and intelligence.
questions.explain: Sau tính từ strong và nối bằng and với danh từ intelligence → cần danh từ determination (sự quyết tâm). determine (v), determined (adj), determining (V-ing) sai từ loại.

questions.q: A _____ is a doctor who performs operations in a hospital.
questions.explain: surgeon: bác sĩ phẫu thuật – người thực hiện ca mổ. soldier (người lính), pharmacist (dược sĩ), patient (bệnh nhân) không đúng định nghĩa.

questions.q: My mother _____ a teacher-training college in Hue in the 1990s.
questions.explain: attend + school/college (không giới từ): theo học trường… participated và took part cần in; went cần to – nên đều sai.

questions.q: Her diary contains personal _____ of her experiences during the war.
questions.explain: account (n): lời kể, bản tường thuật – personal accounts of her experiences. counts (sự đếm), amounts (lượng), accountants (kế toán viên) không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: In 2003, Jobs was _____ with a rare form of cancer, but he continued to work for several years.
questions.explain: be diagnosed with + bệnh: được chẩn đoán mắc bệnh. discovered with, recognised with không phải collocation; infected with dùng cho bệnh truyền nhiễm do vi khuẩn/virus, không dùng cho ung thư.

questions.q: Toy Story was a huge success, and it was followed by other _____.
questions.explain: blockbuster: phim bom tấn, rất thành công về doanh thu – hợp với 'huge success… followed by other…'. biographies (tiểu sử), diaries (nhật ký) sai chủ đề; failures (thất bại) trái nghĩa với ngữ cảnh.

questions.q:
Choose the word(s) OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
By making computers smaller and cheaper, Apple made them <u>accessible</u> to everyday users.
questions.explain: accessible: dễ tiếp cận, dễ sử dụng → trái nghĩa là difficult to obtain or use. easy to reach or use là đồng nghĩa; cheap to produce, attractive to look at không liên quan.

questions.q: Catherine II was _____ to her adopted country and worked hard to make Russia a great nation.
questions.explain: be dedicated to: tận tụy, hết lòng với – hợp nghĩa. addicted to = nghiện; interested đi với in; excited đi với about – sai giới từ hoặc sai nghĩa.

questions.topic: Expressing pleasure and responding to it
questions.q:
Choose the best response.
Mark: "I've just learnt that my poem has won the first prize in the poetry competition!"
Nam: "_____ It's a very inspiring poem."
options: I'm on top of the world!
questions.explain: Nam đáp lại tin vui của bạn → dùng câu đáp lại niềm vui: I'm so happy for you! 'I'm on top of the world' và 'It was such a pleasure' là câu tự bày tỏ niềm vui của mình; 'Never mind' dùng để an ủi.

questions.topic: Expressing pleasure and responding to it
questions.q: I've just heard that I passed the university entrance exam with top marks. I'm _____ the moon!
questions.explain: Thành ngữ be over the moon = vui sướng tột độ (tương đương on top of the world, on cloud nine). Không nói on/above/under the moon với nghĩa này.

questions.q: I _____ a good book at 10 p.m. last night, so I didn't hear the doorbell.
questions.explain: Mốc thời gian cụ thể trong quá khứ (at 10 p.m. last night) → hành động đang diễn ra → quá khứ tiếp diễn was reading. am reading, have read sai thì; read không diễn tả hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm đó.

questions.q: Mary _____ a few pages of her book and went to bed.
questions.explain: Chuỗi hành động hoàn tất nối tiếp nhau trong câu chuyện (… and went to bed) → quá khứ đơn read. reads, has read sai thì; was reading không dùng cho sự kiện chính nối tiếp.

questions.q: I was reading a book when the phone _____.
questions.explain: Hành động ngắn xen vào hành động đang diễn ra (was reading) → quá khứ đơn sau when: rang.

questions.q: While I _____ a book, my mother was watching TV.
questions.explain: Hai hành động song song trong quá khứ (while… was watching) → cả hai dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn: was reading.

questions.q: Dang Thuy Tram _____ in Hue in 1942.
questions.explain: Cấu trúc bị động cố định: be born; năm 1942 → quá khứ đơn was born. 'born' thiếu to be; was bearing sai nghĩa; is born sai thì.

questions.q: Tram was killed by the enemy while she _____ her duty in the jungle.
questions.explain: Hành động dài đang diễn ra thì bị cắt ngang (was killed) → quá khứ tiếp diễn sau while: was doing. Các phương án khác là hiện tại, không hợp với câu quá khứ.

questions.q: It _____ heavily, and icy winds were blowing across the city. We lit a fire to keep warm.
questions.explain: Mô tả bối cảnh (setting) của câu chuyện trong quá khứ, song song với were blowing → quá khứ tiếp diễn was snowing.

questions.q: My dad _____ a documentary about war heroes at 9 p.m. on 30 April.
questions.explain: Thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ (at 9 p.m. on 30 April) → hành động đang diễn ra: was watching.

questions.q: She _____ school and _____ to college at the age of 18.
questions.explain: Hai hành động hoàn tất, nối tiếp nhau (and), có mốc at the age of 18 → đều dùng quá khứ đơn: finished / applied. Quá khứ tiếp diễn không dùng cho chuỗi sự kiện chính.

questions.q: When Walt Disney was a child, he _____ drawing and painting.
questions.explain: love là động từ trạng thái, không chia tiếp diễn → quá khứ đơn loved. loves, has loved sai thì.

questions.q: "What _____ at 8 o'clock last night? I called you, but nobody answered."
questions.explain: Hỏi hành động đang diễn ra tại một thời điểm cụ thể trong quá khứ (at 8 o'clock last night) → were you doing. Hỏi 'did you do' là hỏi việc đã làm (hoàn tất), không hợp ý 'lúc đó bạn đang làm gì mà không nghe máy'.

questions.q: When I arrived at the party, my friends _____ and singing happily.
questions.explain: Hành động đang diễn ra khi một hành động khác xảy ra (arrived) và song song với 'singing' → were dancing (and [were] singing). danced không ghép được với 'and singing'.

questions.q: Vo Thi Sau _____ some French soldiers when she was only 14.
questions.explain: Sự kiện đã hoàn tất trong quá khứ (when she was only 14 – mốc tuổi) → quá khứ đơn attacked.

questions.q: As Tram _____ through the jungle, she _____ by the enemy.
questions.explain: Hành động dài (đang đi) bị hành động ngắn xen vào → was walking; Tram bị giết → bị động quá khứ đơn was killed. 'killed' chủ động sai nghĩa (cô ấy giết), was killing sai cả thể lẫn thì.

questions.q: The diary _____ by an American soldier, who kept it for more than 30 years.
questions.explain: Chủ ngữ the diary chịu tác động, có by an American soldier → bị động quá khứ đơn was found. found, was finding, has found là chủ động, sai nghĩa.

questions.q: We _____ dinner when the lights suddenly went out.
questions.explain: Hành động đang diễn ra (ăn tối) bị hành động ngắn xen vào (the lights went out) → quá khứ tiếp diễn were having.

questions.q: Walt Disney _____ Mickey Mouse in 1928, and the character soon _____ very popular.
questions.explain: Hai sự kiện chính đã hoàn tất, nối tiếp nhau, có mốc in 1928 và soon → đều dùng quá khứ đơn: created / became.

questions.q: At this time last year, my brother _____ for his university entrance exam.
questions.explain: At this time last year (vào thời điểm này năm ngoái) → hành động đang diễn ra tại thời điểm xác định trong quá khứ: was studying.

questions.q: I _____ my keys while I was walking to school.
questions.explain: Hành động ngắn (làm mất chìa khóa) xảy ra trong lúc hành động dài đang diễn ra (was walking) → quá khứ đơn lost.

questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I was having a bath while my friend phoned me.
I have a bath when my friend phoned me.
I was had a bath when my friend phoned me.
I was having a bath when my friend phoned me.
questions.explain: Câu đúng: hành động dài was having bị hành động ngắn phoned xen vào, dùng when trước hành động ngắn. while không đặt trước hành động ngắn; 'have' sai thì; 'was had' sai cấu trúc.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: family /ˈfæməli/: a đọc /æ/. age /eɪdʒ/, saved /seɪvd/, famous /ˈfeɪməs/: a đọc /eɪ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: love /lʌv/: o đọc /ʌ/. soldier /ˈsəʊldʒə(r)/, wrote /rəʊt/, home /həʊm/: o đọc /əʊ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: crown /kraʊn/: ow đọc /aʊ/. shows /ʃəʊz/, grow /ɡrəʊ/, known /nəʊn/: ow đọc /əʊ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: said /sed/: ai đọc /e/. painting /ˈpeɪntɪŋ/, fail /feɪl/, rain /reɪn/: ai đọc /eɪ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: says /sez/: ay đọc /e/. day /deɪ/, played /pleɪd/, stay /steɪ/: ay đọc /eɪ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: broad /brɔːd/: oa đọc /ɔː/. boat /bəʊt/, coast /kəʊst/, approach /əˈprəʊtʃ/: oa đọc /əʊ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: leader /ˈliːdə(r)/: ea đọc /iː/. great /ɡreɪt/, break /breɪk/, steak /steɪk/: ea đọc /eɪ/ (ba trường hợp đặc biệt).

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: founded /ˈfaʊndɪd/: ou đọc /aʊ/. shoulder /ˈʃəʊldə(r)/, soul /səʊl/, though /ðəʊ/: ou đọc /əʊ/.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: animated /ˈænɪmeɪtɪd/ nhấn âm 1. biography /baɪˈɒɡrəfi/, achievement /əˈtʃiːvmənt/, impressive /ɪmˈpresɪv/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: admire /ədˈmaɪə(r)/ (động từ) nhấn âm 2. surgeon /ˈsɜːdʒən/, childhood /ˈtʃaɪldhʊd/, marriage /ˈmærɪdʒ/ (danh từ) nhấn âm 1.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: publish /ˈpʌblɪʃ/ nhấn âm 1. devote /dɪˈvəʊt/, adopt /əˈdɒpt/, defeat /dɪˈfiːt/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: dedicated /ˈdedɪkeɪtɪd/ nhấn âm 1. ambitious /æmˈbɪʃəs/, intelligent /ɪnˈtelɪdʒənt/, accessible /əkˈsesəbl/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
My father joined the army when he was 24.
options: My father was 24 years old after he left the army.
My father joined the army at the age of 24.
My father joined the army for 24 years.
My father was joining the army at the age of 24 years.
questions.explain: when he was 24 = at the age of 24 (vào năm 24 tuổi). Các câu khác đổi nghĩa (rời quân ngũ, phục vụ 24 năm) hoặc sai cấu trúc (at the age of 24 years, thì tiếp diễn không hợp).

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Tram was killed while she was doing her duty in the jungle.
options: Tram was killed after she had finished her duty in the jungle.
Tram was doing her duty in the jungle when she was killed.
Tram did her duty in the jungle after she was killed.
Tram was killing while she was doing her duty in the jungle.
questions.explain: Câu gốc: Trâm đang làm nhiệm vụ thì bị giết. Đổi vị trí: hành động dài was doing + when + hành động ngắn was killed – giữ nguyên nghĩa. Các câu khác sai trình tự sự việc hoặc sai thể bị động.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
The diary was published in Viet Nam in 2005.
options: The diary published in Viet Nam in 2005.
The diary has been published in Viet Nam since 2005.
They published the diary in Viet Nam in 2005.
They were publishing the diary in Viet Nam before 2005.
questions.explain: Chuyển bị động quá khứ đơn sang chủ động: They published the diary… 'The diary published' thiếu was; 'has been… since 2005' và 'were publishing… before 2005' đổi nghĩa về thời gian.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Uncle Ho was respected because of his simple lifestyle.
options: People admired Uncle Ho for his simple lifestyle.
Uncle Ho admired people for their simple lifestyle.
People admired Uncle Ho although he had a simple lifestyle.
Uncle Ho was admired to his simple lifestyle.
questions.explain: be respected because of = được ngưỡng mộ vì → People admired Uncle Ho for… Câu đảo chủ thể sai nghĩa; although sai quan hệ nguyên nhân; admired to sai giới từ.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Jobs left college after only six months without finishing his studies.
options: Jobs graduated from college after only six months.
Jobs dropped in college after only six months.
Jobs attended college for more than six months before graduating.
Jobs dropped out of college after only six months.
questions.explain: left college without finishing his studies = dropped out of college (bỏ học giữa chừng). graduated là tốt nghiệp (trái nghĩa); drop in (ghé qua) sai nghĩa; câu cuối sai thông tin.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Catherine II wasn't born in Russia, but she ruled it for 34 years.
options: Because Catherine II wasn't born in Russia, she ruled it for 34 years.
Catherine II was born in Russia and ruled it for 34 years.
Although Catherine II wasn't born in Russia, she ruled it for 34 years.
Although Catherine II wasn't born in Russia, but she ruled it for 34 years.
questions.explain: but (tương phản) = Although… Câu với Because sai quan hệ nghĩa; câu 'was born in Russia' sai thông tin; không dùng Although và but cùng lúc.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
I was reading a book. The phone rang.
options: I read a book when the phone was ringing.
I was reading a book when the phone rang.
The phone was ringing while I read a book.
While the phone rang, I was reading a book.
questions.explain: Hành động dài (was reading) bị hành động ngắn (rang) xen vào → was reading… when… rang. Các câu khác đảo vai trò dài/ngắn hoặc đặt while trước hành động ngắn.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
My mother was cooking dinner. At the same time, my father was watching TV.
options: While my mother was cooking dinner, my father was watching TV.
When my mother cooked dinner, my father watched TV.
My mother cooked dinner after my father watched TV.
Because my mother was cooking dinner, my father was watching TV.
questions.explain: Hai hành động song song (at the same time) → While + QKTD, QKTD. Câu với when + QKĐ diễn tả nối tiếp/thói quen; after sai trình tự; because sai quan hệ nguyên nhân.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Steve Jobs met Steve Wozniak in 1971. Wozniak was five years older than him.
options: In 1971, Steve Jobs met Steve Wozniak, who was five years older than him.
In 1971, Steve Jobs met Steve Wozniak, which was five years older than him.
In 1971, Steve Jobs met Steve Wozniak, that was five years older than him.
Steve Jobs, who was five years older than Wozniak, met him in 1971.
questions.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định bổ nghĩa cho người (Steve Wozniak) → , who… which dùng cho vật; that không dùng sau dấu phẩy; câu cuối đảo thông tin (Jobs lớn tuổi hơn).

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Vo Thi Sau was very young. She bravely fought against the French soldiers.
options: Because she was very young, Vo Thi Sau bravely fought against the French soldiers.
Vo Thi Sau was too young to fight against the French soldiers.
Despite she was very young, Vo Thi Sau bravely fought against the French soldiers.
Although she was very young, Vo Thi Sau bravely fought against the French soldiers.
questions.explain: Hai ý tương phản (rất trẻ – vẫn dũng cảm chiến đấu) → Although + mệnh đề. Because sai quan hệ; too young to fight phủ định ý câu gốc; Despite không đi với mệnh đề.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
While my grandfather <u>fought</u> (A) in the war, my grandmother <u>was taking</u> (B) care <u>of</u> (C) the <u>whole</u> (D) family.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: hai hành động song song kéo dài, mệnh đề với while cần quá khứ tiếp diễn → sửa fought thành was fighting.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Steve Jobs <u>attended</u> (A) Reed College, but he <u>found</u> (B) the classes boring and <u>was dropping</u> (C) out <u>after</u> (D) six months.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: chuỗi sự kiện hoàn tất nối tiếp (attended… found… and…) → quá khứ đơn: sửa was dropping thành dropped.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Thomas Edison <u>is</u> (A) admired <u>for</u> (B) his <u>impressive</u> (C) <u>achieve</u> (D) in science.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: sau tính từ sở hữu his và tính từ impressive cần danh từ → sửa achieve thành achievements.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Dang Thuy Tram devoted her <u>youth</u> (A) <u>to save</u> (B) other people's lives <u>during</u> (C) the war <u>against</u> (D) the US.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: devote something to + V-ing (to là giới từ) → sửa to save thành to saving.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
I <u>was reading</u> (A) a biography of Walt Disney <u>while</u> (B) the phone <u>rang</u> (C) <u>in</u> (D) the living room.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: trước hành động ngắn xen vào (rang) dùng when, không dùng while → sửa while thành when.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Elizabeth I <u>was ruling</u> (A) England <u>for</u> (B) 45 years and <u>defeated</u> (C) the <u>powerful</u> (D) Spanish Navy in 1588.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: hành động đã kết thúc trọn vẹn trong một khoảng thời gian (for 45 years) → quá khứ đơn: sửa was ruling thành ruled.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
My grandparents <u>had</u> (A) a <u>long</u> (B) <u>marry</u> (C) and lived happily <u>together</u> (D) for 60 years.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: sau mạo từ a và tính từ long cần danh từ → sửa marry thành marriage (have a long marriage).

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Steve Jobs <u>was diagnosed</u> (A) with cancer in 2003 and <u>passed</u> (B) away <u>two months</u> (C) after he <u>was stopping</u> (D) working in 2011.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: hành động ngắn, hoàn tất ở mốc 2011 → quá khứ đơn: sửa was stopping thành stopped.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (1).
questions.explain: Sau tính từ difficult cần danh từ; collocation have a difficult childhood (có tuổi thơ khó khăn). childish là tính từ; children/child không hợp nghĩa 'had a difficult…'.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (2).
questions.explain: attend school: đi học (đến trường). join (gia nhập), take, make không tạo collocation đúng với school theo nghĩa này.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (3).
questions.explain: Hành động đang diễn ra (làm đồng) thì bị hành động ngắn xen vào (when… asked) → quá khứ tiếp diễn was working.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (4).
questions.explain: Sau tính từ long and happy cần danh từ → marriage (have a long and happy marriage).

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (5).
questions.explain: devote one's life to + V-ing: cống hiến cả cuộc đời cho việc… → to helping others.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (6).
questions.explain: the most + tính từ + danh từ; nghĩa bị động 'được ngưỡng mộ' → admired. admiring (đầy ngưỡng mộ – chỉ người ngưỡng mộ) sai nghĩa; admiration (n), admire (v) sai từ loại.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (7).
questions.explain: While + hành động dài đang diễn ra trong quá khứ, bị xen vào bởi met → quá khứ tiếp diễn was studying.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (8).
questions.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định thay cho người (Pierre Curie), làm chủ ngữ của became → who. which dùng cho vật; whom làm tân ngữ; whose chỉ sở hữu.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (9).
questions.explain: Sau were truly cần tính từ mô tả bản chất của thành tựu → impressive (ấn tượng). impressed chỉ cảm xúc của người; impression (n), impress (v) sai từ loại.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (10).
questions.explain: pass away = qua đời, hợp với ngữ cảnh 'sức khỏe bị tổn hại… năm 1934'. went away (đi xa), gave away (cho đi), dropped away (giảm dần) sai nghĩa.
